opening.quote: Good morning, thank you for calling Tidewell Home, my name is Sanne.
opening.comment: You greeted the caller and gave your name and the company name, which meets the standard.

verification.quote: Can I take your full name and either the order number or the postcode on you account, please?
verification.comment: You asked for the full name and order number before accessing the order, which is correct; the caller then gave both, so the check was properly completed.

understanding.quote: So you were charged €49.99 twice one lamp, and you only want the duplicate payment you know back, is it right?
understanding.comment: You misstated the amount as €49.99 when you had just read €49.95, which is a slip in capturing the issue, though the caller's actual issue was understood and confirmed.

resolution_accuracy.quote: I've refunded the duplicate thank you payment of €49.95 today. Your bank will show it within 3 to 5 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The refund amount, same-day refund and 3 to 5 working day bank timeline all match the duplicate charge policy.

process_compliance.comment: No hold, photo, chargeback or voucher step applied to this call, so no process steps were missed.

communication.quote: I'm it sorry about that, being charged twice is really frustrated.
communication.comment: You acknowledged the caller's annoyance, but the wording was garbled ('really frustrated' instead of 'really frustrating'), so please slow down and speak clearly.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I could help you with?
closing.comment: You confirmed the next step (confirmation email), asked if there was anything else, and closed politely.
